The '''Square Sea''' was an artificial [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] located 800 [[Meter/Legends|kilometers]] west of [[Acablas/Legends|Acablas]].

==Overview==
An artificial body of water, the Square Sea was 500 by 500 kilometers in size. Designed so that each of its faces was aligned with the cardinal points on a compass, the Sea was located close enough to the [[Acablas/Legends|Acablas]] [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] that locals suggested either the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] or the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] had a hand in its creation. Despite many stories, the reason or the means for its construction were lost to history.<ref name="NoP" />
